sources.researchNote: The date identifies the Bamboodi digital issue released on 29 January 2018; 1938 is the year of the underlying performance for Everybody Sing. The release names no original session, label, catalogue number or matrix. It replaces an Audiomack page that carried the same performance without credits and refused playback outside its licensed territories.
